headline: Binance Prepares Withdrawal Restart Following $6.3 Billion Security Breach
summary: Binance CEO Richard Teng stated hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks during a $6.3 billion exploit. The exchange targets a Sunday withdrawal restart and plans to publish proof of reserves on Monday.
why: Binance is one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges globally, and security breaches or large-scale exploits of this magnitude can impact market liquidity, regulatory scrutiny, and investor confidence across digital assets.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: The security breach and halt on withdrawals directly affect the platform's operations and user access.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A multi-billion-dollar exploit and the temporary halt of withdrawals on a major global cryptocurrency exchange raise concerns about platform security and liquidity, impacting market sentiment.
